body:
Owner: I read Panela, Barnett, Barense, Herrmann 2025 (Commun Psychol 3:187; EventRecall). You are right. It is not elite.

What they published. GPT-4 or LLaMA copies the story and starts a new line at event boundaries. Temperature 0 is the normative cut. Twenty model runs are treated as twenty subjects. Recall is the max Spearman of embeddings between those pieces and the recall pieces, then an average. One number. They resize a rectangular match matrix to a square so the arithmetic fits. Humans agreeing more with the LLM than with each other is sold as validation. It is also the tell: the model is more stereotyped than people, and the score is being pulled toward that stereotype.

That is this code red in print. A provider writes the segmentation. A cosine-family score treats the cut as given. Alternatives exist (temperature 0.5 and 1) and then disappear from the number that matters.

The external guidance is right on the diagnosis: a heuristic proposal and a resolved observation currently inhabit the same type. Segmentation is a latent variable, not preprocessing. An idea unit must not be the only recall ontology. I agree.

I do not agree with boiling that into one first ADR. LatticeHsmm, audio, ten gates, and renaming Checked to WellFormed in Slice A is a second library. The close that matches the paper tonight:

- Label the current door baseline-heuristic.
- A non-forgeable wrapper so a heuristic graph cannot enter a population constructor.
- Construction receipt on HsmmResult.
- Boundary high-impact, not Ordinary.
- MAP/legacy RecallGraph remains a view.

Renaming Checked is honest only if WellFormed still means "the parts fit," not "the science is settled." The wrapper does the work. A new name without the wrapper is the Level defect.

We are not elite yet. If we run GraphHsmm on unlabeled segmenter units and say we beat EventRecall, we have done their sin with more types. The thing they cannot publish is the thing we must: this score is conditioned on this licensed cut, here are the alternatives, here is what was omitted.

Still no slice. Still no implementation.
